integrity: The proof is analytic and the separately reproducible finite computations are auxiliary; no authorship, empirical provenance, or independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Sharp conditional one-step worst-direction expected squared-error gain only. Not an exact infinite-time MSE exponent. Strict SPD unit-row correlation family and fixed independent sampling are required; full unrestricted probability simplex is covered. No independent validation.
title: Exact optimal Kaczmarz sampling for an equicorrelated block with one exceptional row
